description: Na₂VBAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.66 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.10 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.31-1.45 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-50°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.73 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one V and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one As atom.
